2026-10-03 stage-owned-texture-mapping:1980native texture/cube/volume map cases and459surface cases. CPU2D/cube paths accept ignored hints incl tested unknown bit1, READONLY|DISCARD and bounded empty/unaligned-BC rectangles; volume and DEFAULT paths validate flags/ranges. DEFAULT ordinary textures reject locks; DYNAMIC accepts qualified maps. DEFAULT cube DISCARD rejects; dynamic2D/volume null top-level DISCARD succeeds; lower2D/cube DEFAULT DISCARD rejects. Duplicate same-subresource locks reject without breaking first Unlock; separate mips can lock together. Failed operational locks zero mapping outputs. DEFAULT standalone DONOTWAIT is valid but observed WASSTILLDRAWING while pending. RT row pitch has provider padding (64 vs owned minimum32 in8x8ARGB case), not portable fixed ABI. OwnedTextureMapping now uses Store sessions/owned row buffers, exact upload regions, CPU flag normalization, owner-supplied busy status, worker/race exclusion and reset replay; WARP pixels and legacy native-lock CPU regression pass. BeginOwnedLock rejects overlap before poisoning a lease; legacy native BeginLock remains unchanged. Empty CPU map has no write authority; out-of-bounds/reversed inputs reject. Component is not wired to live COM/factory callbacks yet. No renderer DLL build/deployment.

2026-10-03 stage-depth-texture-contract native host evidence: dynamic DEFAULT bare D16/D24S8/D24X8 sampled via ps_3_0 tex2Dproj (w=1), level0, point or linear filtering, clamp addressing. 81 uniform texel threshold searches plus210 filter rows establish: D24S8 depth=float((word>>8)/16777215), D24X8=float((word>>8)/16777216), low8 ignored by comparison. D16 uses low16 and clamps/rounds the comparison reference to UNORM16, round-half-up with exact intermediate precision; raw32767 fails at reference0.5. Negative refs pass; D16 max passes positive infinity; floating D24 comparison does not clamp >1; NaN comparisons return0. Linear filtering blends per-texel boolean comparisons. Standard DX11 R16 comparison alone differed at a half-step and treated NaN as0-ref; the new HLSL helper uses exact 40-bit integer product emulation to quantize D16 references and explicit isnan rejection. Conversion uses R16_UNORM for D16 and R32_FLOAT for the two measured D24 encodings. All858 native/modern comparison results now match in WARP; bounds/unreadable-input/unchanged-output tests also pass. Component is NOT connected to production Store/shader/sampler routing; public bare-depth creation stays rejected until all those paths are integrated. LOD, other opcodes, address modes, w-edge cases and other depth formats remain unqualified. This describes host-provider API behavior, not Oblivion disassembly or DSV memory layout; do not transplant into arbitrary depth/stencil semantics. Evidence: analysis/dx11_completion/stage-depth-texture-contract/result.md.

2026-10-03 stage-sampled-depth-storage: Source now has an explicit owned Description.sampledDepth interpretation (plugin metadata, not a native ABI member). For qualified DEFAULT 2D/surface D16/D24S8/D24X8 payloads without depth-stencil/render-target usage, Store retains exact raw CPU bytes and mapping/alias/replay semantics; GPU publication converts to R16_UNORM or R32_FLOAT comparison views. GPU views expose the native sampled-depth format. Description equality seals the interpretation. Raw readback uses retained CPU data because D24 GPU conversion loses the ignored low byte. GPU writes/copies, RTV/DSV use and unqualified sRGB views remain rejected. The flag is false for ordinary native inspection/public creation: shader/sampler routing and wider sampling/transfer contracts must be completed before activation. Release renderer and four targeted checks passed: sampled-depth storage actual GPU pixels and raw readback/worker/partial/reset/retirement, existing depth resources, color publication and1932-case public factory matrix. Existing15 factory exclusions remain unchanged. Artifacts archived, NOT deployed; V233/High INI unchanged. Evidence: analysis/dx11_completion/stage-sampled-depth-storage/result.md. Implementation validation, not a new Oblivion binary layout claim.

[Renderer capture fix validated 2026-10-02, stage-shader-token-capture] Raw-word END search has been replaced in source by bounded SM1 operand-count / SM2+ encoded-length / COMMENT-length framing. D16 uses low16 and clamps/rounds the comparison reference to UNORM16, round-half-up with exact intermediate precision; raw32767 fails at reference0.5. Negative refs pass; D16 max passes positive infinity; floating D24 comparison does not clamp >1; NaN comparisons return0. Linear filtering blends per-texel boolean comparisons. Standard DX11 R16 comparison alone differed at a half-step and treated NaN as0-ref; the new HLSL helper uses exact 40-bit integer product emulation to quantize D16 references and explicit isnan rejection. Conversion uses R16_UNORM for D16 and R32_FLOAT for the two measured D24 encodings. All858 native/modern comparison results now match in WARP; bounds/unreadable-input/unchanged-output tests also pass. Component is NOT connected to production Store/shader/sampler routing; public bare-depth creation stays rejected until all those paths are integrated. LOD, other opcodes, address modes, w-edge cases and other depth formats remain unqualified. This describes host-provider API behavior, not Oblivion disassembly or DSV memory layout; do not transplant into arbitrary depth/stencil semantics.
